policy.name: Lowest Price Guarantee
policy.fullTermsSource: Full legal text supplied by the user on 2026-10-28 (freshco.com blocks automated fetches with HTTP 403).
policy.rule: If a discount supermarket competitor within the local store's geographic trade area offers a lower price on an item FreshCo carries, FreshCo sells it for 1 cent less than the competitor's advertised price on showing the competitor's current flyer (print or digital).
policy.eligibleCompetitorNote: Up to four (4) discount competitors in the trade area. In Ontario: No Frills, Food Basics, Real Canadian Superstore, Wal-Mart. Locations may vary by store; FreshCo determines competitors and trade area at its discretion.
policy.identityRequirement: Identical items (same brand, size and attributes). Private label: comparable competitor private-label product of same size and attributes.
policy.evidenceRequirement: Competitor's current flyer, print or digital.
exclusions: Competitor e-commerce platforms or online pricing
Products sold by in-store third party vendors
Prescriptions, gift cards, liquor, tobacco, products that may not be discounted by law
'Free' promotions and discounts obtained through loyalty or other customer programs
Banners owned, operated or franchised by Sobeys Capital Incorporated
policy.discretion: FreshCo reserves the right to determine competitors, trade area and comparable items per store, to change the program without notice, and to withdraw the guarantee from customers it determines are abusing it.

recommendationRule: FreshCo (Milton) is the fixed home store. Only offers from the Ontario eligible competitors (No Frills, Food Basics, Real Canadian Superstore, Wal-Mart) may be labelled price-matchable at FreshCo, and only for identical brand/size/attribute items, max 4 units, with current-flyer evidence. Offers from any other merchant are shown as not price-matchable at FreshCo. Matched price shown to the user should reflect the 1-cent beat where the competitor price is known.
